title: (Re)Discover KTEQ
body:
After 55 years of broadcasting from the the campus of South Dakota Mines, KTEQ-FM is getting a little much-deserved TLC.

## What's Happening

We're in the middle of a top-to-bottom refresh: new studio equipment, new programming tools, a new website (you're looking at it), and a renewed commitment to the independent radio philosophy that's defined this station since 1971, but with a refocused commitment to listener experience, student development, and sustainability. 

## Why Now

KTEQ has always been what you might generously call "scrappy." The station has oscillated between vibrantly, vitally weird; kinda WTF unpredictably weird; and just plain non-operational, then back again more than a few times. But somehow, despite the odds, it keeps coming back for more. We've moved frequencies, rebuilt/relocated studios, and weathered every financial, legal, and logistical challenge a typical student-run station can face. 

In October 2025, during our most recent bout of FM silence (turns out our venerable transmitter needed to be refurbished) we were inducted into the South Dakota Rock & Rollers Hall of Fame - a timely reminder that our odd, improbable little station has been a vital cultural touchstone for Rapid City for two generations now, in spite of naysayers' assertions that Rapid City is too small and the internet is too smart for independent radio to exist, let alone thrive here.  We'll see. If you know, you know.

In 2026, trust in corporately-owned algorithms is faltering. Meanwhile, student interest in radio is on the rise. We have a fantastic opportunity to share the station's rich history of weird perseverance while connecting the next generation of independent artists with local listers. Now is the time to build something that will last for the next 55 years.

## What's Coming

- **Studio renovation** through summer 2026
- **New 24/7 programming** with new specialty music blocks being added all summer. 
- **55th Anniversary** digital yearbook with year-by-year music recaps, and more! 
- **Studio grand reopening** and a return to live broadcasts during M-Week 2026
- **New fundraising opportunities** to support studio equipment upgrades and maintenance, future broadcast upgrades, and paid student positions 

Stay tuned. We're just getting started.
excerpt: 55 years in, KTEQ is launching a top-to-bottom refresh: new paint, new carpet, new equipment, but also maybe something more substantial?
author: KTEQ Staff
